subject: Mythology
title: Hindu Mythology in Bollywood
description: Learn Hindu Mythology in Bollywood in one minute.

hook.text: Bollywood produces over 1,500 films a year, and mythological themes run through nearly all of them.

buildup.text: The 1987 TV series Ramayan drew 650 million viewers, making it one of the most-watched shows in television history.

discovery.text: Modern films like Baahubali and RRR use mythological archetypes: divine heroes, cosmic stakes, and dharmic duty.

twist.text: Even romantic Bollywood films echo myth: lovers separated by duty, tested by fate, reunited by devotion.

climax.text: Hindu mythology is not just in temples. It lives in the stories India tells itself every single day on screen.

punchline.text: The world's largest film industry runs on stories older than civilization.

quiz.question: How many viewers did the 1987 Ramayan TV series attract?
